verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official Stripe CLI for building, testing, and managing Stripe integrations (including Terminal) directly from the terminal, documented at docs.stripe.com/cli and confirmed via probe. Missing for 10: no evidence of Terminal-specific CLI commands or AI-native/agentic CLI features (e.g., natural-language or agent-oriented CLI workflows), and no independent hands-on review of the CLI itself.
